notes.title: BARPG | Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Next Fest is here! [/h1]
[h3][b]I'm happy to announce that BARPG is showcased through October 21st![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175959/19c9d5ed2ef6f81491413c3c542860dc0d8aaaa9.png[/img]

To me, this is an exciting opportunity to get the playable demo into more aspiring bartenders' hands. 

[i]So without further ado...
[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189710/BARPG/

[h3]To all new players:[/h3]
Hello!! Welcome to the world of BARPG, I hope you thoroughly enjoy your time with the demo. You will play through your first seven days at this unassuming local bar, learning the tools of the trade, bettering your skills, and making decisions. [b]Be your own. [/b]Please do not hesitate to leave feedback, as it will help me to deliver the full game in the best possible state that I can. 

[h3]To all ongoing players: [/h3]
Words cannot describe how much your support means to me, and I'm elated to know that so many of you are having fun playing the demo thus far. From the bottom of my heart, thank you so, so very much! ːluvː

[i][h3]From the development desk:[/h3]
I can't wait to share more details about some massive changes coming to the full game, as well as the intended release date. Life has been certainly doing its thing lately, so I've had to slightly dial back the time I've been giving to daily development. That being said, I'm expecting to be through the thick of it and be back in full-swing very soon, at which point I can properly share things I've been working on.[/i]

[i]Cheers!
- Gavlov[/i]

notes.title: BARPG on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175959/64f0ee318b41f1fd74444bb8b7aa883c4370cba0.png[/img]
[h1]To Players on Steam Deck:[/h1]
Hello there! I haven't forgotten about you, and I'm working on making sure this game is fully playable to you, in the best state it possibly can. As of now, the demo should be fully playable using a controller layout I have created myself. Please follow the steps listed below to give it a shot:
[olist]
[*]With the game running, open Controller Layouts in the Steam Deck menu.
[*]Select the so-called "Official Layout" in order to change it. Change tabs over to the "Community Layouts". 
[*]If no community layouts show up, press the "X" button to "Show all Layouts"
[*] Select the layout uploaded by me, titled "GavLov's Steam Deck Profile".
[/olist]

[h3]Some Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The layout should work out of the box, somewhat as a hybrid of the gamepad controls and the Mouse Controls.
[*]Button glyphs are not entirely accurate at the moment, specifically for "grabbing". By default, grabbing is handled by pressing the right trackpad, which moves the mouse. Grabbing is NOT done by using the gamepad glyph displayed on screen (LT by default). Working on handling this.
[*]RT pours the bottle, with pressure dependence deciding the angle of pour. I feel this works better than trying to emulate the "bottle flipping" mechanic of Mouse gameplay with the trackpad. If you feel differently, you can certainly remap the 'Start Pour' button using the in-game controls remapping. Remapping this button to anything [i]other than[/i] a Trigger or Analog Stick will enable bottle flipping just like the Mouse/Keyboard controls.
[/list]

[h3]Please do vote on this community layout to increase its visibility, as well as leave community posts if you enjoyed/disliked the layout or have your own suggestions for its improvement! All of this will help me be able to get the game verified for steam deck usage upon launch.[/h3]

[h2]Cheers Deck Users![/h2]

notes.title: BARPG Demo is Out!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]WE MADE IT Y'ALL[/h1]
[/b]

[h2]The demo for BARPG is officially live, and playable now.[/h2]
Was there a potentially game-breaking bug that needed to be patched immediately? Of course, this is a game launch after all. But I couldn't be happier with the reception so far, and I look forward to everyone playing the game in the near future. Please feel free to leave feedback with the button on the main menu, all input is welcome to make this game the best it can possibly be!


If the main menu screen does [b]NOT[/b] display [b]V0.7.7[/b] in the bottom right corner, please do right click on the game in your library, press 'Properties', then 'Installed Files' to perform the "Verify Integrity of Game Files" step once. This will ASSURE that you are on the most up-to-date version of the game, and avoid any chances of you encountering any of the aforementioned bugs.

[h3]KNOWN BUGS:[/h3]
[list]
[color=red][*] [i]There is a ghost in the apartment. I wish I could say this was some cool lore, but no it's a collision ghost. [/i]
On rare occurrences, your player character will be blocked by an invisible wall while trying to walk through your apartment, and you will be slowly pushed to the right. Extensive playtesting is underway to solve this issue, I will keep you all updated on when this gets fixed. 
[b]For now, if you experience this bug, use the pause menu, select "Quit to Desktop" and reload the game. The issue will be fixed, progress saved, and hopefully the ghost does not return for the rest of your playthrough.[/b][/color]

[color=yellow][*]  On rare occasions, a spill cannot be swept up, resulting in a deduction to pay. SORRY, WILL LOOK INTO THIS ONE AND SOLVE HOPEFULLY QUICKLY!![/color]

[color=lightblue] [*] Some dialogue can be partially obscured by UI elements when text is set to the maximum size in options. [/color]

[/list]

[h3]DAY 1 FIXES :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bottle glug sounds will now no longer get stuck in an infinite loop if pouring while shift ends.

[*] Tutorial sequence break that occurred with regards to the radio is now fixed.

[*] Layering of decor has been adjusted to not obscure player.

[*] Known UI elements that could obscure mouse inputs now should no longer do that. (I hope there aren't more but time will tell)

[*] Paintings and signs randomly being altered and/or duplicated by a ghost are now free of any paranormal activity.

[*] Decor now spawns on day 7 after [spoiler]Landlord arrives[/spoiler].

[*] Recipe score multipliers now persist over days. (Yeah that was almost game-breaking, thanks Cesar)

[*] Last Call sequence is now displayed to the player, and lasts longer, giving more time to clean up messes without new customers entering.

[*] Location of spills has been altered to improve visibility

[*] Added Biscayne Blvd by Sylvan LaCue b/c its a classic and a banger, I somehow didn't already add it.

[/list]
